Weighted-average shares (Class A, B and Exchangeable)
paragraph_requires: (in thousands, except share and per share amounts)
The Company’s calculation of weighted-average shares outstanding includes the exchangeable shares
For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company reported a net loss and therefore basic and diluted loss per share were the same
decisions.reader_note: For Recursion in 2023–2025, the selected weighted-average denominator combines Class A, Class B and Exchangeable common stock. The filing treats the subsidiary’s exchangeable shares as substantially economically equivalent to Class A and already includes them in weighted-average shares; they should not be added again as potential dilution. Other potentially dilutive shares are excluded in these loss periods. Full scale-zero share counts and EPS retain the main statement’s share/per-share exception to the thousands heading.
